issues.title_en: PM orders proactive response to heavy rains, flash floods, landslides in northern Vietnam
issues.summary: Prime Minister Pham Minh Chinh urged authorities in provinces and cities from Quang Tri northward, along with relevant ministries and agencies, to take urgent measures to ensure public safety and minimise damage caused by natural disasters. Heavy rains batter northern provinces as flood, landslide risks rise Floods, whirlwinds leave four dead or injured in northern localities Floods, landslides wreak havoc on northern mountainous region
